# HIPAA Vault

> HIPAA Vault provides affordable, compliant cloud hosting and communication solutions purpose-built for healthcare organizations handling protected health information (PHI).

HIPAA Vault offers a comprehensive suite of HIPAA-compliant services including hosting (WordPress, Windows, Linux), encrypted communications (email, messaging, fax), and secure file transfer. The platform emphasizes managed security, Business Associate Agreements (BAA), and rapid compliance readiness for healthcare providers and organizations.

## Key Topics

- HIPAA Compliance
- Business Associate Agreement (BAA)
- Protected Health Information (PHI)
- WordPress Hosting
- Windows Server Hosting
- Linux Hosting
- Encrypted Email
- Google Workspace
- Office 365
- sFTP Server
- Managed Security
- Cloud Storage
- Healthcare Compliance

## Core Hosting Solutions

- [HIPAA Hosting Solutions](https://www.hipaavault.com/hipaa-hosting-solutions): Main HIPAA hosting solutions for WordPress, Windows, and Linux platforms
- [HIPAA Compliant WordPress Hosting](https://www.hipaavault.com/hipaa-compliant-wordpress): HIPAA WordPress hosting with 30-day trial, SSL, and 24/7 support
- [Secure Windows Cloud Hosting](https://www.hipaavault.com/hipaa-compliant-windows-hosting): HIPAA Windows Server cloud hosting with managed services and WAF
- [HIPAA Compliant Linux Hosting](https://www.hipaavault.com/linux-hosting-plan): HIPAA Linux hosting with managed infrastructure and security patching
- [HIPAA WooCommerce Hosting](https://www.hipaavault.com/hipaa-compliant-woocommerce-hosting): HIPAA WooCommerce e-commerce hosting with managed security and MySQL
- [Enterprise Solutions on Google Cloud](https://www.hipaavault.com/enterprise): Enterprise HIPAA solutions on Google Cloud with Kubernetes support

- [HIPAA Compliant Email](https://www.hipaavault.com/hipaa-compliant-email): HIPAA encrypted email with Google Workspace and Office 365 integration

- [Office 365 HIPAA Compliance](https://www.hipaavault.com/hipaa-outlook-office-365): Office 365 HIPAA compliance with Outlook and Azure protection
- [HIPAA Compliant Fax](https://www.hipaavault.com/hipaa-fax): HIPAA compliant fax service for secure healthcare document transmission
- [HIPAA Compliant Texting](https://www.hipaavault.com/hipaa-text): HIPAA encrypted texting for patient and staff communication
